name: ARH-Whisper-Board
description: ARH Whisper Board Native Capabilities & Invariants Specification

capabilities.name: Proximate Edge Protection
capabilities.description: Asymmetric touch boundaries and gravity wells accommodating thumb retraction undershoot on outer keys (A, Q, Z, P, M) and preventing destructive misfires on Backspace and Enter.

capabilities.name: Touch Calibration Wizard
capabilities.description: Interactive active-learning calibration mode with targeted drill prompts, empirical drift vector calculation, and an undoable/revertible checkpoint history stack.

capabilities.name: Touch Beam Decoder
capabilities.description: Noisy-channel spatial beam search over landed taps and language model priors, finding intended words directly from tap distance evidence.

capabilities.name: STT Cloud Streaming WebSocket
capabilities.description: Real-time duplex 16kHz PCM audio streaming over persistent WebSocket directly to Whisper backends with ~180ms time-to-first-token.

capabilities.name: On-Device Whisper Fallback
capabilities.description: Local Sherpa-ONNX quantized Whisper Tiny Q5_1 offline speech recognition engine requiring zero network connectivity.

capabilities.name: AI Prompt Rewording
capabilities.description: Direct keyboard smartbar integration with OpenRouter and local LLMs for one-tap text rewording (Executive, Grammar, BM Formal, Bulletize).

capabilities.name: Markdown Clipboard History
capabilities.description: Room database persistent clipboard with HTML-to-Markdown table ingestion, code fence retention, and auto-H1 file exporter.

capabilities.name: Transactional Clipboard Undo
capabilities.description: 10-item transient revision ring buffer preventing destructive clipboard overwrites and data loss.

capabilities.name: Zero-GC Touch Dispatch
capabilities.description: Allocation-free hot touch loop eliminating MotionEvent iterator allocations in Compose gesture handling for locked 60/120 FPS.

capabilities.name: Snygg Theme Engine
capabilities.description: Declarative CSS-like styling parser and dynamic Material You color palette adaptation.

capabilities.name: Floris Smartbar
capabilities.description: Dynamic quick-action bar providing word suggestions, voice toggle, clipboard manager drawer, and prompt chips.

capabilities.name: Custom Quick Text Snippets
capabilities.description: Smartbar quick-access snippet engine allowing instant 1-tap insertion of user-defined commands and texts (e.g. /resume, /usage, /clear) at cursor without view switching.
